description: This file acts as a barrel module that re-exports collections of security audit functions, divided into synchronous and asynchronous sets, for use in a larger security auditing framework within a project.

methods.name: collectAttackSurfaceSummaryFindings
methods.description: Function that collects findings related to attack surface summary.

methods.name: collectExposureMatrixFindings
methods.description: Function that collects findings for exposure matrix.

methods.name: collectGatewayHttpNoAuthFindings
methods.description: Function that collects findings regarding HTTP endpoints without authentication.

methods.name: collectGatewayHttpSessionKeyOverrideFindings
methods.description: Function that detects and collects findings on session key overrides in HTTP gateways.

methods.name: collectHooksHardeningFindings
methods.description: Function that assesses and reports on security hardening of hooks.

methods.name: collectLikelyMultiUserSetupFindings
methods.description: Function that detects multi-user configurations.

methods.name: collectMinimalProfileOverrideFindings
methods.description: Function examining profile override security issues.

methods.name: collectModelHygieneFindings
methods.description: Function for analyzing model hygiene concerns.

methods.name: collectNodeDangerousAllowCommandFindings
methods.description: Function that detects dangerous command allowing configurations.

methods.name: collectNodeDenyCommandPatternFindings
methods.description: Function for detecting command pattern restrictions.

methods.name: collectSandboxDangerousConfigFindings
methods.description: Function that reports dangerous sandbox configurations.

methods.description: Function to identify no-op Docker sandbox configurations.

methods.name: collectSecretsInConfigFindings
methods.description: Function that detects secrets embedded in configurations.

methods.name: collectSmallModelRiskFindings
methods.description: Function analyzing risks associated with small models.

methods.name: collectSyncedFolderFindings
methods.description: Function that reports issues with synced folders.
